sys_atf_test.description: Calls ITFRoutingResolver.resolve() for the Commerce, Health and Shared Administrative Services departments and asserts each returns its own expected director, OPM analyst and OPM group, every one looked up by natural key rather than hardcoded. Proves the ITF Department Routing decision table discriminates between departments instead of returning one row for everything, and includes an unmapped department as the negative case.
sys_atf_test.name: ITFRoutingResolver resolves a distinct director, analyst and group for each department
